description_en: Adds a destination address to a targeted group
description_zh: 定向分组新增目标地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkcard add-directional-address --group-id 10000002595 --source user_defined --address-type Domain --address 0.aliyun.com --serial-no 123123 --msg-notify false --url-insecurity-force false --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDirectionalAddress

parameters.help_en:
The address type. Valid values:

- user_defined: user-defined configuration.
- aliyun_defined: Alibaba Cloud predefined configuration
parameters.help_zh:
地址类型：

客户配置： user_defined

阿里云预配：aliyun_defined
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The destination address type. Valid values:

- Ip: IP address.
- Domain: domain name
parameters.help_zh:
目标地址类型：

Ip：Ip

域名：Domain
parameters.name: address_type

parameters.help_en: The request number. This parameter supports idempotence
parameters.name: serial_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to push a notification through MQ after successful execution. Default value: false. Valid values:
- false: does not push a notification.
- true: pushes a notification (currently not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
执行成功后是否通过MQ推送，默认false：
false：不推送
true： 推送（目前不支持）
parameters.name: msg_notify

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly add a detected high-risk domain name. By default, the domain name is blocked and not added
parameters.help_zh: 检测到的高危风险域名是否强制添加，默认被拦截，不添加
parameters.name: url_insecurity_force
